MFU side: measured full-coverage vLLM FP8 prefill = 91.7–98.3% vs the 989 TFLOPS bf16 denominator (46–49% vs 1979 FP8-native), but with vLLM's ONLINE scheme = per-TENSOR weight + per-token activation; the "88–98%" is the per-channel-adjusted band obtained by multiplying by a first-party single-shape per-channel/per-tensor GEMM ratio 0.886 (1265/1427 TFLOPS) — the per-channel config was NEVER measured end-to-end in vLLM (llm-compressor↔vLLM _C.abi3.so env-block). D" last-token logits); KL on first 10 windows. MFU config: vLLM quantization="fp8", dtype=float16, enforce_eager=False, prefix-cache OFF, distinct synthetic prompts, B∈{8,16}×S∈{2048,4096}, prefill isolated as t(mt=1)−(t(mt=2)−t(mt=1)) best-of-4, FLOPs=2·7.241e9·BS+2·32·B·32·S²·128, denominator 989e12, sustained 1418–1485 MHz / 647–694 W. vLLM-source consultation (installed 0.20.2, may differ from the 2026-05 container) corroborates: online fp8 = per-tensor static weight (kFp8StaticTensorSym, ops.scaled_fp8_quant(weight, scale=None)) + dynamic per-token activation (kFp8DynamicTokenSym when CUTLASS fp8 supported); lm_head unquantized (get_quant_method only matches LinearBase; ParallelLMHead is a VocabParallelEmbedding); vLLM's torch _scaled_mm fallback passes NO use_fast_accum.
